gloss: allotted time; time available to a player or speaker

definitions.gloss: allotted time; one's own share of time
definitions.explanation: The amount of time assigned to one side or one person — a player's clock in shogi, go, or chess, or the minutes given to a speaker or presenter. Once it runs out, the turn or the talk is over.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{時間|じかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅっぷん}→十分：09572_juppun⟧です。
{持|も}ち{時間|じかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}り→残り：01622_nokori⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた。
examples.english: There is not much time left on my clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{対局|たいきょく}→対局：17420_taikyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{持|も}ち{時間|じかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{使|つか}い{切|き}る→使い切る：11518_tsukaikiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一手|いって}⟦{一分|いっぷん}→一分：30314_ippun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{指|さ}さ→指す：02056_sasu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Each player has three hours in this match, and once that is used up they must move within one minute per move.

notes:
⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to hold) plus ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time): the time one "holds" and may spend as one likes. Standard vocabulary in board games and in conference or debate programs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {持|も}ち{時間|じかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{切|き}る→使い切る：11518_tsukaikiru⟧: to use up one's time
- {持|も}ち{時間|じかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: to run out of time
- {持|も}ち{時間|じかん}⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧: to keep within the time allotted
- ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧{持|も}ち{時間|じかん}⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧: three hours each

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{制限|せいげん}{時間|じかん}→制限時間：30577_seigenjikan⟧: time limit — an upper bound on how long something may take, not a personal allowance
- ⟦{時間切|じかんぎ}れ→時間切れ：30253_jikangire⟧: running out of time — the state of having exhausted it
